Explain why Agile + V-Model Hybrid is recommended for End-to-End Instant Unsecured Personal Loan Origination based on regulatory criticality of 5/5.

Agile + V-Model Hybrid is recommended for End-to-End Instant Unsecured Personal Loan Origination due to high regulatory criticality (5/5) and stringent audit requirements under RBI Digital Lending Directions 2022. The model pairs early iterative user-story prototyping for the user experience with formal V-Model verification gates (unit, integration, and regulatory acceptance testing) to ensure zero statutory compliance regressions prior to deployment.

Why is pure Rapid Application Development (RAD) inappropriate for End-to-End Instant Unsecured Personal Loan Origination despite potential delivery speed advantages?

Pure Rapid Application Development (RAD) was evaluated and strictly rejected for End-to-End Instant Unsecured Personal Loan Origination. Given retail loans regulatory exposure and security criticality of 4/5, RAD's compressed documentation and lack of formal independent verification gates violate statutory auditability mandates. Skipping formal architecture reviews risks non-compliant data retention schemas and unacceptable regulatory fines.
